picture-pairs.name: Tifanekiso letifanako
picture-pairs.seoTitle: Umdlalo Wekufanisa Wesifo Sekukhohlwa: Tifanekiso Letifanako
picture-pairs.description: Umdlalo wekufanisa lomahhala lomnene labaphila nesifo sekukhohlwa. Tifanekiso letikhulu tihlala tikhombisiwe, akukho sikhatsi noma umphumela, nawe ukhetsa tifanekiso letu-4 kuya ku-12.
picture-pairs.short: Tfola letimbili letifanako. Tifanekiso tingahlala tikhombisiwe.
picture-pairs.intro: Thinta sifanekiso, bese uthinta lesifanana naso. Tifanekiso tihlala tikhombisiwe ngekusemandla, kutsi kungadzingeki kukhumbula lutfo. Lapho tifanekiso letimbili tihambisana, titfola umcu wegolide nemakha wekuhlola.
howTo: Khetsa kutsi ufuna tifanekiso letingaki. Tifanekiso letine kuba yindzawo lenhle yekucala.
Thinta noma yisiphi sifanekiso. Sitfola umcu wegolide.
Thinta sifanekiso lesibukeka sifanana nalesi. Letimbili tihlala tihambisane, nemakha wekuhlola.
Uma tifanekiso letimbili sihlukile, akukho lesibi lesenteka. Thinta futsi nakusulungele.
Vula “Tifanekiso letifihliwe” kuphela uma nina bobabili nitfokotela inguguko lephelile, lapho tifanekiso tibekwe phansi.
tips: Tfola tifanekiso ndzawonye nicocisana ngato: “Likomishi lelibomvu letiyi. Ungasifaka yini lubisi etiyini lakho?”
Vumela umuntu lonakekelako ente kutinta, nakutsatsa sikhatsi lesidze. Khomba ngesandla esikhundleni sekutinta ngaye.
Hlala ne-4 tifanekiso sikhatsi lesidze lesikujabulisa. Tifanekiso letengetiwe kufanele kube sinqumo, hhayi lilinga lekufika kulo.
Qeda ngesikhatsi kusajabulisa. Umdlalo munye ngumsebenti lophelele.

faq.a: Cha. Akukho sikhatsi, umphumela, sibalo semagadango noma kulahlwa. Ungamisa nanini, futsi kumisa ngesikhatsi lesiphakathi kuyindlela lenhle yekuphetsa.

Kugcina tifanekiso tibukeka kwenta umdlalo ube kubuka nekufanisa, hhayi kukhumbula. Bantfu labanyenti bayitfola incono. Ungashintsha kutifanekiso letifihliwe ngekucindzeteka kanye, uma ukhetsa lokunjalo.

faq.q: Ingahhala yini, futsi kudzingeka ngabhalisa yini?
faq.a: Yebo, ihhala, futsi akudzingeki i-akhawunti, kubhalisa noma kulanda. Isebenta kusiphequluli seweb kumfowini, ithebulethi noma kukhompyutha.
Yebo. Zama “Tifanekiso Tesithombe”, lokukuvumela kutsi ukhetse tithombe kusuka kudivayisi yakho. Tithombe tihlala kusiphequluli sakho futsi tingalaywa.

find-the-same.name: Tfola lofanako
find-the-same.seoTitle: Tfola Sifanekiso Lesifanako: Umdlalo Lulula Wesifo Sekukhohlwa
find-the-same.description: Sifanekiso sinye phezulu, letimbili kuya kwetine ngaphansi. Thinta lesifanana naso. Umdlalo wetifanekiso lomnene lomahhala labaphila nesifo sekukhohlwa, ngaphandle kwesikhatsi.
find-the-same.short: Bukisisa sifanekiso lesiphezulu bese uthinta lesifanana nasi ngaphansi.
find-the-same.intro: Sifanekiso sinye sihlala phezulu esikrinini. Ngaphansi kwaso kukhona letimbili, letintsatfu noma letine. Thinta lesifanana naso. Kusinqumo lesilula ngasikhatsi, nendzawo lenkhulu yekuchuluka.
howTo: Khetsa letimbili, letintsatfu noma letine tifanekiso lotakukhetsa kutsi. Letimbili kuba lula kakhulu.
Bukisisa sifanekiso lesiphezulu ndzawonye.
Thinta sifanekiso lesifanana nasi ngaphansi. Siphawulwa ngemakha nemagama lafudumele.
Uma kuthintwa sifanekiso lesehlukile, umdlalo uyasichaza bese uyalinda. Thatha sikhatsi sakho.
Thinta “Sifanekiso lesilandzelako” nawusulungele lelinye.
tips: Chuluka ngetifanekiso ngaphambi kwekukhetsa: emibala, timo, nalapho ungasibona khona.
Tikhetho letimbili akusho “kulula kakhulu”. Injongo kukujabulisa, hhayi kulinga.
Uma kuthinta kunzima, umuntu angakhomba futsi wena umthinte ngaye.

faq.a: Cha. Akukho sikhatsi, umphumela, sibalo semagadango noma kulahlwa. Ungamisa nanini, futsi kumisa ngesikhatsi lesiphakathi kuyindlela lenhle yekuphetsa.

faq.q: Kwenteka kani uma kuthintwa sifanekiso lesingafanani?
faq.a: Akukho lenkinga lengenteka. Akukho ticamu, akukho sikhalo lesibomvu lesikhombisa kungalungi, futsi akukho kugedzeka. Umdlalo uchaza sifanekiso lesithintiwe bese ulinda kuthinta lokulandzelako.

faq.q: Ingahhala yini, futsi kudzingeka ngabhalisa yini?
faq.a: Yebo, ihhala, futsi akudzingeki i-akhawunti, kubhalisa noma kulanda. Isebenta kusiphequluli seweb kumfowini, ithebulethi noma kukhompyutha.

shadow-match.name: Kufanisa sithunzi
shadow-match.seoTitle: Umdlalo Wekufanisa Sithunzi Wesifo Sekukhohlwa: Mahhala Ku-inthanethi
shadow-match.description: Sithunzi lesimnyama phezulu, tifanekiso letimbili kuya kwetine ngaphansi. Thinta sifanekiso lesenta lesithunzi. Umdlalo lomahhala lomnene wekufanisa sithunzi wesifo sekukhohlwa, ngaphandle kwesikhatsi.
shadow-match.short: Bukisisa sithunzi bese uthinta sifanekiso lesisenta sona.
shadow-match.intro: Kufanisa sithunzi ngumsebenti lowatiwa kakhulu kumashidi lasiphrintiwe, lapha nje ngetifanekiso letikhulu futsi kungadzingeki kuphrinta lutfo. Sithunzi lesithambile sihlala phezulu esikrinini, tifanekiso letimbili, letintsatfu noma letine tilinde ngaphansi. Thinta lesenta sithunzi. Tindzawo letifana nebhayisikili, sambulela noma likomishi letiyi nato tiyasheshe kukhulunyiwa ngato.
howTo: Khetsa letimbili, letintsatfu noma letine tifanekiso. Letimbili kuba lula kakhulu.
Bukisisa sithunzi ndzawonye. Sibukeka kanjani? Siphakeme yini noma sibhulungu?
Thinta sifanekiso lesenta sithunzi. Libito lalo livela ngaphansi kwesithunzi.
Uma kuthintwa sifanekiso lesehlukile, umdlalo uyasichaza bese uyalinda. Thatha sikhatsi sakho.
Thinta “Sithunzi lesilandzelako” nawusulungele lesinye.
tips: Landzela umjikelo wesithunzi ngumunwe bese ukhuluma ngalesimo.
Uma sithunzi sibonakala sinzima namuhla, shintsha ku-Tfola lofanako, lapho tifanekiso tifana khona.
Khuluma ngesifanekiso kanjena nasitfoliwe: “Besinesambulela lesifana naleso.”

faq.a: Cha. Akukho sikhatsi, umphumela, sibalo semagadango noma kulahlwa. Ungamisa nanini, futsi kumisa ngesikhatsi lesiphakathi kuyindlela lenhle yekuphetsa.

faq.q: Ukuhlanganisa emathunzi kuhle yini kubantfu labanesifo sekukhohlwa?
faq.a: Kungaba umdlalo lomnandzi nolula kulabanye bantfu, ikakhulu esigabeni sekucala. Timumo tilula kutigcina kunemagama. Yindlela yekujabula nekuxoxa, hhayi lovivinyo, futsi ayelaphi noma ayinciphisi sifo sekukhohlwa. Uma kukhatsatekisa, zama “Thola lofanako” noma nibukisise tithombe ndzawonye.

faq.q: Kwenteka ni uma kuchayiwa sithombe lesingakafaneli?
faq.a: Akukho lokubi lokwenteka. Kute ticamamlilo, kute tinkhanyelo letibomvu nekugungguleka. Umdlalo utsi sithombe lesichayiwe bese ulindzele kuchaya lokulandzelako.
Yebo, kuyamahhala, futsi akukho ti-akhawunti, kubhalisa noma kulanda. Kuyasebenta ku-web browser kufoni, ku-tablet noma kukhompyutha.

sort-together.name: Hlela ndzawonye
sort-together.seoTitle: Umdlalo Wekuhlela Kubantfu Labanesifo Sekukhohlwa: Hlela Ndzawonye
sort-together.description: Chayani sithombe, bese nichaya lenkhuseni lesifanele kuyo: ekhishini noma egcweleni, sithelo noma tilwane. Umsebenti lotulile lowahhala wekuhlela labantfu labanesifo sekukhohlwa.
sort-together.short: Faka sithombe ngasinye enkhuseni yaso: ekhishini noma egcweleni, nemanye.
sort-together.intro: Kuhlela ngumsebenti lowatiwa kahle futsi lojabulisako emalanga onkhe, njengekubeka tintfo ekhabethini noma kuhlanganisa emasokisi. Chayani sithombe, bese nichaya inkhuseni lapho lesifanele khona. Akukho kusheshisa futsi akukho kuphambuka lokungalungile.
howTo: Khetsani indzikinsi: ekhishini negcweleni, sithelo netilwane, noma ekhaya nasemaphandleni.
Chayani sithombe. Siba nemgca wegolide.
Chayani inkhuseni lesifanele kuyo. Sithombe sitawungena kuleyo nkhuseni.
Uma sifanele enye inkhuseni, umdlalo utsi kahle bese ulindzele.
Lapho sonkhe tithombe sesihlelekile, bukisisani tinkhuseni ndzawonye.
tips: Empilweni yansuku ngensuku akusoze kube nemphendvulo lengalungile. Uma umuntfu atsi sipho sekuntjitsa sifanele ekhishini, buta ngekutsi kungani. Ungakutfola kuhle lokutsi.
Sebentisani tithombe njengesikhumbuzo: “Nalitelela yini egcweleni lakho?”
Kuhlela tintfo langempilo, njengemacembe nemafolokhwe noma tinkinobho ngemibala, kuba ngumsebenti lomuhle lolandzelako ngaphandle kwesikrini.

faq.a: Akukho. Akukho sikhathi, umphumela, kubala tintfutfo noma kulahlekelwa. Ungamisa noma nini, futsi kumisa uhhafu kuyindlela lenhle yekuphetsa.
Bantfu abanyenti bajabulela kuhlela ngoba kuva njengemsebenti lowusitfolako futsi lowatiwa kahle. Kuphindze kube lula kuxoxa ngetithombe lapho nichubeka.
Yebo, kuyamahhala, futsi akukho ti-akhawunti, kubhalisa noma kulanda. Kuyasebenta ku-web browser kufoni, ku-tablet noma kukhompyutha.

picture-puzzle.name: Puzzle yesithombe
picture-puzzle.seoTitle: Puzzle Lula Yekubantfu Labanesifo Sekukhohlwa: Tincumo 4 noma 9
picture-puzzle.description: Puzzle lula ku-inthanethi kubantfu labanesifo sekukhohlwa: tincumo letinkhulu letingu-4 noma 9, sonkhe sithombe sihlala sibonakala, futsi nichaya tincumo letimbili kuze ticinise ndzawo.
picture-puzzle.short: Chayani tincumo letimbili kuze tishintsane kuze sithombe siphelele.
picture-puzzle.intro: Sithombe lesimnandzi sisikwa sibe tincumo letine noma lesipheta letinkhulu futsi sixutjwe. Sonkhe sithombe sihlala sibonakala njengesiqondziso. Chayani incumo linye, bese lelinye, futsi tiyashintsha tindzawo. Akudzingeki kudonsa.
howTo: Khetsani sithombe netincumo letine noma letipheta. Letine kuba kucala kuhle.
Bukisisani sithombe sonkhe esendzaweni lephezulu.
Chayani incumo, bese nichaya sindzawo lapho lesifanele khona. Tincumo letimbili tiyashintsha.
Tincumo lesendzaweni lefanele tiba nemaki lamancane lakhangako.
Lapho sithombe siphelele, sijabulele ndzawonye, bese nikhetsa lesinye.
tips: Kuchaya tincumo letimbili kutishintsha kulula kakhulu kunekudonsa kubantfu abanyenti.
Khulumani ngesithombe lesihlanganako: “Nalapha lophahla lolubomvu.”
Puzzle yemapulangwe langempilo lenetincumo letili-12 kuya ku-24 letinkhulu nayo ingumsebenti lomuhle etafuleni.

faq.a: Akukho. Akukho sikhathi, umphumela, kubala tintfutfo noma kulahlekelwa. Ungamisa noma nini, futsi kumisa uhhafu kuyindlela lenhle yekuphetsa.
Akudzingeki. Chaya incumo linye, bese lelinye, tiyashintsha tindzawo. Kulula kakhulu nasandla sinyenyetela noma esikrinini lesincane.
Yebo, kuyamahhala, futsi akukho ti-akhawunti, kubhalisa noma kulanda. Kuyasebenta ku-web browser kufoni, ku-tablet noma kukhompyutha.

finish-the-saying.name: Phetsa inkhulumo
finish-the-saying.description: Tinkhulumo letijwayelekile tesiSwati letilishoda ligama lekugcina, njengo “Umuntfu ngumuntfu nga___”. Chayani sikhetho noma khombisa siphetso, bese nikhuluma ngakho.
finish-the-saying.short: Phetsani tinkhulumo letijwayelekile ndzawonye, bese nikhuluma ngato.
finish-the-saying.intro: Tinkhulumo letindala tivame kwatiwa iminyaka yonkhe. Ikhadi ngalinye likhombisa inkhulumo lejwayelekile lelishoda ligama lekugcina, tikhetso letintsatfu, nenkinobho “Khombisa siphetso”. Ngemuva kwesiphetso, umbuto lomnandzi uvulela kuxoxa.
howTo: Fundani inkhulumo ngekuphimisa ndzawonye.
Chayani ligama lelitfola lokuphetsa, noma chayani “Khombisa siphetso”.
Fundani inkhulumo lenkhulu futsi nikhuluma ngayo nisebentisa umbuto.
Chayani “Lelandzelako” lapho nilungele.
tips: Fundani kancane futsi nimise kancane ngaphambi kweligama lekugcina. Kuvame kutsi bantfu batsi lisho ngaphambi kwekutsi uliphetse.
Uma umuntfu anikela siphetso lesihlukile, nikujabulele. Tinkhulumo letinye tiyahluka ngemndeni noma ngendzawo.
Uma niliqembu, umuntfu mnye afundza bese bonkhe bajoyina ekuphetseni.

faq.a: Cha. Alikho iwashi, umphumela, sibalo semanyatselo noma kulahlekelwa. Ungayeka nanoma nini, futsi kuyeka uhhafu kuyindlela lenhle yekuphetsa.
Umdlalo ukhombisa kuphela kwendlela ejwayelekile bese uyaya engxoxweni. Alikho umphumela, futsi impendulo lehlukile iyemukelekile.
Yebo, kuyamahhala, futsi alikho akhawunti, kubhalisa noma kulanda. Kuyasebenta kwibhrawuza yewebhu efonini, ethebulethini noma ekhompyutheni.

word-search.name: Umdlalo wemagama lamakhulu
word-search.seoTitle: Umdlalo Wemagama Lamakhulu Wesifo Sekukhohlwa, Ungawuphrinta
word-search.description: Umdlalo wemagama lamakhulu lamahhala wabadzala nalabaphila nge-dementia. Emagama ambalwa, tinhlamvu letikhulu, ahamba ngecala nangaphansi kuphela. Dlala ku-inthanethi noma uphrinte.
word-search.short: Tinhlamvu letikhulu, emagama ambalwa, ahamba ngecala nangaphansi kuphela. Uyawuphrinta futsi.
word-search.intro: Ligrid lelincane netinhlamvu letikhulu nemagama ambalwa, onkhe afundeka ngecala noma ngaphansi. Thinta inhlamvu yekucala yelivi, bese uthinta leyekugcina. Ukhetsa iphepha? Uphrinte luhla oluhlakile ngekucindzetela kunye.
howTo: Khetha indzikinyo nobukhulu begridi.
Bukisisa luhla lwemagama. Emagama afundeka ngecala (kusuka ngesobunxele kuya ngesokudla) noma ngaphansi (kusuka phezulu kuya phansi).
Thinta inhlamvu yekucala yelivi, bese uthinta leyekugcina.
Livi lelitfoliwe liyagcotjwa futsi liyacolwa ohlwini.
Thinta "Phrinta lomdlalo" uze udlale ngephepha nangepeni noma ngemakhalamu.
tips: Khombisa livi ohlwini uyibukisise inhlamvu yalo yekucala ndzawonye.
Ephepheni, umakhalamu wekukhanyisa ulula kubambeka kunepeni.
Khuluma ngemagama alendzikinyo. Emagama etitselo ayindlela lenhle yekuya etinkhumbulweni tekukhetsa, kubhaka nasemakethe.

faq.a: Cha. Alikho iwashi, umphumela, sibalo semanyatselo noma kulahlekelwa. Ungayeka nanoma nini, futsi kuyeka uhhafu kuyindlela lenhle yekuphetsa.
Yebo. Thinta "Phrinta lomdlalo" uphrinte ligrid lamanje ngetinhlamvu letikhulu, nluhla lwemagama ngaphansi kwalo. Lomdlalo ngamunye lomusha uhlukile.
Yebo, kuyamahhala, futsi alikho akhawunti, kubhalisa noma kulanda. Kuyasebenta kwibhrawuza yewebhu efonini, ethebulethini noma ekhompyutheni.

coloring.name: Emaphepha ekudaya
coloring.description: Emaphepha ekudaya labadzala, lalula, anetindzawo letikhulu: thinta umbala, bese uthinta sitfombe. Akukho kuhlanta, akukho mibala lephosile, futsi lilphepha ngalinye lingaphrintwa mahhala.
coloring.short: Thinta umbala, bese uthinta lencenye yesitfombe. Uyawuphrinta emaphepha futsi.
coloring.intro: Emaphepha anemimumo lemikhulu lelulalula: lilumbu esitsiyeni, indlu, inkomishi yetiyi, libhabhathane nelibhothi lelisebenta ngemoya. Thinta umbala, bese uthinta incenye yesitfombe ukuze uyigcwalise. Akukho mibala lephosile.
howTo: Khetha liphepha.
Thinta umbala. Umbala ngamunye unelibito lawo lelibhalwe kuwo.
Thinta incenye yesitfombe ukuze uyigcwalise ngalowo mbala.
Ungashintja umcabango nanoma nini ngekugcwalisa kabusha.
Thinta "Phrinta leliphepha" uze utfole liphepha lelingenalutfo lokudaya ngemapensela noma ngemakhalamu.
tips: Nika imibala lemibili yekukhetsa esikhundleni sesethi lephelele uma kukhetsa kukhanya kakhulu.
Tihlahla letibovu netilanga letiluhlaza ayemukelekile. Lokubalulekile kujabula ngemibala, hhayi kuba lichaneko.
Emaphepha laphrintiwe asebenta kahle nemakhalamu lamakhulu noma tinkhwishi, letilula kubambeka.

faq.a: Cha. Alikho iwashi, umphumela, sibalo semanyatselo noma kulahlekelwa. Ungayeka nanoma nini, futsi kuyeka uhhafu kuyindlela lenhle yekuphetsa.
Sidzwe sitfombe letisibekelo letiyatuliseka, hhayi emahlaya. Imifanekiso lemikhulu yenta kudaya kube lula kodvwa kungabi ngekwebantfwana.
Yebo, kuyamahhala, futsi alikho akhawunti, kubhalisa noma kulanda. Kuyasebenta kwibhrawuza yewebhu efonini, ethebulethini noma ekhompyutheni.

conversation-cards.name: Emakhadi ekuxoxisana
conversation-cards.seoTitle: Tinkhulumo Letimnene Ngesifo Sekukhohlwa: Emakhadi Etifanekiso
conversation-cards.description: Emakhadi etifanekiso anetinkhulumo letimnene letivula kuxoxisana kulabaphila nge-dementia: akukho kubuvisa, akukho timphendvulo letilungile. Sebentisa ku-iskrini noma uphrinte sonkhe.
conversation-cards.short: Emakhadi etifanekiso anemibuto lemnene leyivulekile. Akukho kuhlola.
conversation-cards.intro: Likhadi ngalinye linesitfombe lesaziwako nesimemo lesivulekile sekukhuluma, njenga kutsi "Yiluphi luhlobo lwemoya olutsandza kakhulu?" Akukho timphendvulo letilungile futsi akukho lokufanele ukukhumbula. Khetsa indzikinyo noma xuba konkhe.
howTo: Khetsa indzikinyo, noma gcina "Emakhadi onkhe".
Funda umbuto ngelizwi lelikhulu ubukisise sitfombe ndzawonye.
Lalela, wabelane ngemphendvulo yakho, uvumele kukhuluma kuhambe kahle.
Thinta "Likhadi lelilandzelako" uma usulungile, noma uhlale nelikhadi linye njengoba unesikhatsi lesidzingekako.
Thinta "Phrinta emakhadi onkhe" uwasike ukuze ube nesethi yephepha.
tips: Phendvula umbuto nawe. Kuzwakala njengekuxoxisana, hhayi kubuvisisa.
Landzela indzaba, hhayi tiniqiniso. Uma tincenye tishintja, lokwenteka kuhle.
Uma likhadi linyatsela nentfo lebuhlungu, vuma umuzwa bese uyashintja ngobumnene uye kelinye likhadi.

faq.a: Imibuto lehlola inkhumbulo ingazwakala njengemvivinyo futsi ibangele ihlazo. Timemo letivulekile njenga "Ngitjele ngalokuthi…" tivumela noma ngubani kutfola ingxenye, nanoma angakhumbula kangakanani.
Yebo. "Phrinta emakhadi onkhe" uphrinta sethi lephelele ngetinhlamvu letikhulu, emakhadi lamaningi ekhasini ngalinye, ilungele kusikwa.
Yebo, kuyamahhala, futsi akudzingeki i-akhawunti, ukubhalisa noma ukulanda. Iyasebenta ebhrawuzeni yewebhu ku-foni, ku-thebhulethi noma ku-khompyutha.

photo-pairs.name: Tibhangqwana tetifanekiso
photo-pairs.seoTitle: Yenta Umdlalo Wekuhlanganisa Tibhangqwana Ngetifanekiso Temndeni
photo-pairs.description: Guca tifanekiso takho temndeni tibe ngumdlalo lowucolisekile wekuhlanganisa. Khetsa tifanekiso letimbili kuya kwetisithupha ku-foni, ku-thebhulethi noma ku-khompyutha yakho; tihlala ebhrawuzeni yakho futsi kute tidluliselwe kunoma ngubani.
photo-pairs.short: Khetsa tifanekiso takho uzihlanganise. Kute lokulayishwa.
photo-pairs.intro: Khetsa tifanekiso letimbili kuya kwetisithupha ku-foni, ku-thebhulethi noma ku-khompyutha yakho, bese tiba ngumdlalo wekuhlanganisa netifanekiso letikhulu, letibonakala kahle. Tifanekiso tibonakala kuphela kulelikhasi. Atilayishwa, atigcinwa noma atabelwana, futsi tiyanyamalala uma uvala likhasi.
howTo: Thinta "Khetsa tifanekiso" bese ukhetsa tifanekiso letimbili kuya kwetisithupha.
Lilinye nalilinye lifanekiso livela kabili. Thinta lilinye, bese uthinta lelihlanganako.
Khuluma ngalelinye lifanekiso uma usilitfola.
Lapho usuphelile, vala likhasi noma uthinte "Sula tifanekiso". Kute lokugcinwako.
tips: Khetsa tifanekiso letisobala letinemajabulo netitsandzekako: silwane sasekhaya, sivande, indzawo lotsandzako, lilanga lemshado.
Tifanekiso tetindzawo netintfo tingaba lula kunebantfu, futsi akukho kucindzetelwa kutsi kusho emagama emabito.
Shiya tifanekiso tebantfu labashonile uma vebangase bavuse kudzabuka kwemanyenta, ngaphandle kwekutsi uyati kutsi tiletula induduzo.

faq.q: Tifanekiso takho itilayishelwa kunoma kuphi yini?
faq.a: Cha. Likhasi lifundza tifanekiso letikhetsako ngqo ebhrawuzeni yakho futsi litibonisa esikrinini sakho. Atidluliselwa kithi noma kunoma ngubani lokunye, futsi ayanyamalala uma uvala noma uvuselela likhasi.
Cha. Kute lotimela sikhatsi, umphumela, lokubalwa kwetinyatselo noma kulahlekelwa. Ungamisa nanoma nini, futsi kumisa uhhafu kuyindlela lenhle yekuphetfa.
Hhayi ebhrawuzeni, ngemabomu, kuze kungagcinwa lutfo lwemuntfu. I-app ye-Golden Moments yeyi-iPhone ne-iPad lehlala mahhala ingagcina tikhopi tetifanekiso letikhetsiwe esilwaneni sakho.

picture-bingo.name: Bingo yetifanekiso
picture-bingo.seoTitle: Bingo Yetifanekiso Labadzala Labanesifo Sekukhohlwa: Lesiphrintwako
picture-bingo.description: Bingo yetifanekiso lesiphrintwako lemahhala lamaqembu ekunakekelwa kwabanesifo sekukhohlwa nelabadzala, nelimemezeli lelikhulu lesikrinini. Tifanekiso letikhulu netemagama, emasikwele angu-9 noma angu-16, kute kufundza.
picture-bingo.short: Emakhadi ebingo yetifanekiso lasiphrintwako nelimemezeli lelikhulu lamaqembu.
picture-bingo.intro: Bingo lendlala ngetifanekiso esikhundleni semanombolo, kuze kungabi nalowodzingeka kufundza tincwadzi letincane. Phrinta sheti yemakhadi lahlukile, bese usebentisa limemezeli lesikrinini kuze kubonakale ngalinye lifanekiso likhulu ku-TV, ku-laptop noma ku-thebhulethi.
howTo: Khetsa emasikwele angu-9 noma angu-16 ekhadini ngalinye, nekutsi bangaki badlali.
Thinta "Phrinta emakhadi". Likhadi ngalinye liyahlukana.
Vula limemezeli esikrinini lesikhulu. Thinta "Lifanekiso lelilandzelako" kuze kubonakale ngalinye lifanekiso nelibito laso.
Badlali bagubha lifanekiso lelifanako ekhadini labo ngelitfutfu, inkinobho noma imakhalekhi.
Lilinye nalilinye lomuntfu lagcwalisa umugca, noma likhadi lonkhe, litfola kubongwa. Kute labahlulekako kuleli dlalo: qhubeka nekudlala kuze kube nalomunye umugca.
tips: Sebentisa tintfo letikhulu njengetintfwala temadamu noma tinkhwebu temabhodlela. Tinkinobho letincane tingaba nzima kutfola.
Tibite lifanekiso bese utsi lilusha ngaloyo lifanekiso: "Sikhephe. Ngubani lowake wahamba ngemkhephe?"
Hlala bantfu labakhubatekako kutfola kahle ngakufaka eduzane nesikrini, futsi uhlanganise abasekeli nebadlali labadzinga lusito.
Emasikwele lasheshumane ayanele emaqembu lamaningi. Gcina sikhatsi semdlalo cishe ngemaminithi lamashumi amabili kuya kulamashumi amatsatfu.

faq.q: Ngidlala kanjani bingo yetifanekiso endlini yekunakekela?
faq.a: Phrinta likhadi lilinye ngemdlali ngamunye, faka limemezeli esikrinini lesikhulu lolitfolako, bese ubita tifanekiso kancane, ubite ngalinye ngelibito lalo. Dlala kuze kube nalomunye umugca, kute umuntfu asalele ngaphandle.
Yebo. Phrinta emakhadi lolwadzingako, nalokuphindzaphindzeka lofunako, kusetjentiselwa kwemuntfu nje noma kweliqembu.
Yebo. Lilinye nalilinye sikwele lilifanekiso lelikhulu, nelibito lalo ngaphansi kwalo kulabo labatsandza emagama.

calm-breathing.name: Kuphefumula kancane
calm-breathing.description: Sikhashana sekuphefumula ngekutsula nekwabelana ngaso: sekela lelihle likhula lisincipha kweSitfupha semaphefumulo. Wena uyacala, futsi ungayeka nanoma nini.
calm-breathing.short: Sekela lelicondvwako lekuphefumula kulo. Cala futsi uyeke nawuthanda.
calm-breathing.intro: Ngalesinye sikhatsi umsebenti lolungile kakhulu sikhashana lesitfutfukile. Thinta "Cala", bese uphefumula sekela likhula, uphume lisincipha. Khetsa isivinini lesishesha noma lesikhashana. Akusikwelashwa, kodvwa sikhashana lesitfula lekwabelana ngaso.
howTo: Hlala ngekutfula eduzane nalomunye.
Khetsa isivinini: sikhashana noma sincane.
Thinta "Cala". Phefumula ngesikhatsi sekhula, uphume ngesikhatsi sincipha.
Iyayeka yodvwa emaphefumulweni lasitfupha, noma thinta "Yeka" nanoma nini ulandzela.
tips: Bambatane tandla noma ubeke sandla emkhonweni wemuntfu uma lokho kwamukelwa.
Ungaphikisi. Uma bafisa kubukela kuphela, kulungile.
Uma umuntfu anenkinga yekuphefumula, phefumula ngendlela yekujwayelekile ubukele sekela kuphela. Buta kudokotela ngalokuphathelene nanoma yiphi inkinga yekuphefumula.

faq.a: Cha. Ngusikhashana lelula, lelikhetsekako sekutfula nekuba nemunye. Akusiyo indlela yekwelapha kukhatsateka noma sifo nanoma yini. Khuluma nedokotela ngetinkinga temphilo.

faq.q: Ingabe sekela liyanyakaza ngaphandle kokuba ngiqale yini?
faq.a: Cha. Akukho lenyakazako kuze ucindzetele i-Start, futsi iyayeka ngemuva kwemaphefumulo lasitfupha noma uma ucindzetela i-Stop. Uma lidivayisi yakho ilungiselelwe kunciphisa kunyakaza, emagama ayashintjwa kodvwa lijikijela alikhuli.
Yebo, kuyamahhala, futsi akudzingeki i-akhawunti, ukubhalisa noma kulanda lutfo. Kusebenta esiphequluli sewebhu kufoni, kulithebulethi noma kukhompyutha.
